title: Jem Corbet
html_source:
James J. Corbett, byname Gentleman Jim (born Sep 1, 1866, San Francisco, California, U.S.—died Feb 18, 1933, New York, New York), American world heavyweight boxing champion from Sep 7, 1892, when he knocked out John L. Sullivan in 21 rounds at New Orleans, until Mar 17, 1897, when he was knocked out by Robert Fitzsimmons in 14 rounds at Carson City, Nevada. Corbett was a quick and agile boxer, and he led the movement toward what came to be called scientific boxing.
Encyclopedia Britannica
